## Who is Balaji Rajaram

Balaji Rajaram is a results-driven B2B Technology Marketing professional based in Bangalore, India, with 12+ years of experience across integrated marketing, demand generation, digital growth, content strategy, brand positioning, and AI-powered marketing initiatives for IT Services and technology organizations. He partners with business leaders to build go-to-market strategies, run multi-channel campaigns, build thought leadership, and accelerate marketing-driven pipeline growth. He translates complex technology solutions into customer-focused messaging and uses Generative AI to improve marketing productivity.

## Professional Summary

B2B marketing leadership combined with hands-on digital, SEO, and AI-search expertise. Strong expertise across integrated marketing, solution marketing, digital campaigns, website transformation, marketing analytics, AI-assisted content workflows, SEO, GEO/AEO optimization, executive communications, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

## Core Expertise Areas

1. Technical SEO — technical SEO strategy and audits, crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, on-page SEO, structured data/schema, Core Web Vitals, migrations, performance optimization.
2. SEO Strategy & Analytics — keyword and search intent analysis, SEO strategy and execution, competitor analysis, content optimization, Google Search Console, GA4, GTM, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse.
3. AI Search — AI-driven search, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), LLM discoverability, AI-assisted SEO workflows, Generative AI adoption, prompt engineering.
4. Demand Generation — integrated marketing, demand generation, digital campaigns, website growth, customer acquisition, sales enablement, conversion-focused digital experiences.
5. Content & Messaging — thought leadership, solution narratives, blogs, landing pages, case studies, editorial calendars, executive presentations, technology messaging.
6. Leadership & Collaboration — SEO team leadership, mentoring, work allocation, quality assurance, cross-functional collaboration, developer/content team coordination, reporting, stakeholder communication.

## Chimera Technologies Marketing Portfolio (Full Detail)
Source: https://balajirajaram.wikiseo.in/chimera-technologies-marketing-portfolio

A six-year (2020–2026) B2B marketing portfolio at Chimera Technologies covering SEO, website transformation, content marketing, demand generation, social media, online reputation management (ORM), sales enablement, and cross-functional marketing operations. The role evolved from hands-on SEO execution into integrated, business-focused B2B marketing.

Headline metrics across the six years:
- 6 years of B2B IT services marketing experience.
- LinkedIn community built to 30,000+ followers.
- 40,000+ backlinks built at peak.
- 2 inbound leads converted into clients.

### Year 1 — 2020–2021: Building the SEO & Website Foundation
Focus: website structure, organic search visibility, website experience, social media, local search.
- Recommended and coordinated website improvements: CTA elements, Back to Top functionality, URL restructuring, custom pages, case study layouts, featured services sections.
- Expanded organic search visibility from 5 ranking keywords to 108 keywords.
- Achieved 50 first-page Google keyword rankings.
- Increased website backlinks from approximately 687 to 15,676.
- Added 18 new landing pages, coordinating development and content requirements.
- Managed regular social media publishing and group sharing.
- Managed Google Business Profile activities, including new US and Singapore locations.
- Supported careers-page updates and social promotion of job openings.
Manager recognition: exceeded expectations in SEO and independent execution; praised for managing social media without dedicated content/design support.

### Year 2 — 2021–2022: Expanding Organic Visibility & Digital Marketing
Focus: international search visibility, website content, social media planning, online reputation management.
- Added approximately 30 new ranking keywords, bringing the total to around 130.
- Added 11 landing pages, 6 case studies, and 4 news pages.
- Increased backlinks from approximately 15,676 to 41,200.
- Created 20 US location-focused pages as a pilot international SEO initiative.
- Prepared and executed the digital marketing calendar.
- Designed and published social media content independently.
- Supported ORM and review-generation activities.
Manager recognition: praised for independently managing lead generation, website optimization, social content, and reputation management.

### Year 3 — 2022–2023: Scaling Content, Social Media & Website Marketing
Focus: broader digital marketing, content production, internal communication, events, social growth.
- Added 4 service pages, 44 case studies, 2 event pages, and 16 "Chimera Diaries" pages.
- Grew LinkedIn community to approximately 15,000 followers.
- Managed social updates, festival greetings, organizational communications, LinkedIn Articles.
- Supported internal communications via Zoho Announcements.
- Promoted events through landing pages and social media.
- Worked on website navigation, metadata, and Hreflang tags.
Manager recognition: encouraged to take greater ownership of planning and build an independent marketing calendar — a transition from execution to planning.

### Year 4 — 2023–2024: Growing Brand Presence & Independent Ownership
Focus: website expansion, social growth, online reputation, events, independent execution.
- Grew LinkedIn followers to approximately 20,000.
- Added 4 landing pages, 4 case studies, 3 event pages, 12 Chimera Diaries pages.
- Improved online reputation across Glassdoor and AmbitionBox.
- Supported Project Overview and Solutions Walkthrough marketing assets.
- Added approximately 80 pages to the Singapore website.
- Supported website navigation and menu improvements.
Manager recognition: praised for independent project ownership, event participation, and reputation management.

### Year 5 — 2024–2025: From Digital Execution to Business-Focused Marketing
Focus: connecting marketing to business outcomes — sales enablement, website coordination, reputation management, organizational initiatives.
- Converted an inbound lead into a client (Bahrain-based FinTech ISV).
- Upgraded sales decks into a modern, consistent PowerPoint format.
- Created 7 new Solutions Walkthroughs using Canva; upgraded 24 existing ones to the new format.
- Served as SPOC and internal auditor for ISO 27001 Certification and ISO 9001 Re-Certification.
- Supported basic SEO for an ISV client website.
- Created landing pages for Chennai, Power Platform, Awards & Certifications, and Low-Code/No-Code.
- Grew LinkedIn followers to approximately 25,000.
- Removed 21 one-star reviews and generated 23 five-star reviews through structured ORM.
Manager recognition: recognized for website coordination, independent creative execution, ISO coordination, and ORM as a significant contribution to brand perception.

### Year 6 — 2025–2026: Connecting Digital Marketing to Inbound Business Growth
Focus: bringing together SEO, content, website management, social, inbound marketing, design, ORM, and cross-functional execution.
- Converted an inbound lead into a client (Australian LegalTech enterprise).
- Managed consistent content and marketing execution across website, blogs, case studies, and social media.
- Published approximately 60 blogs and 100+ social media posts.
- Managed website issues: 404 errors, redirects, SSL coordination, page updates, content improvements.
- Continued strengthening ORM through review monitoring and structured review generation.
- Used Canva Pro to create and standardize sales presentations, reducing dependency on the marketing team for routine decks.
- Coordinated with sales, leadership, development, HR, delivery teams, and external vendors.
- Grew LinkedIn community toward 30,000+ followers.
Manager recognition: recognized for strong execution across digital marketing, website management, design, content, ORM, and cross-functional coordination.
